subheader: The same list applies to one practitioner or a group of fifteen.
lead: Items with a cross are add-ons with their own price, or services we do not offer.
note: Add-ons are billed per practice per month. You can cancel them at the end of any billing period. Prices exclude VAT.

items.title: Appointment book
items.text: Rooms and equipment are booked in the same view.

items.title: Waiting list
items.text: Automatic offers by SMS are an add-on at €9 per month.

items.title: Insurance billing
items.text: Claims go out on the first working day of the month.

items.title: Private invoices and reminders
items.text: With your logo and your bank details.

items.title: Treatment documentation
items.text: Findings and reports from your own templates.

items.title: Document storage
items.text: Prescriptions and referrals are scanned straight in.

items.title: Daily off-site backup
items.text: Stored in Austria and restorable for 90 days.

items.title: Data export
items.text: Any time, without having to ask us.

items.title: Support by phone and email
items.text: From 8:00 to 17:00, answered by our own team.

items.title: Printed recall letters
items.text: Add-on. Our print partner handles printing and postage.

items.title: Online booking for patients
items.text: Add-on, cancellable at the end of any billing period.

items.title: Payroll for your staff
items.text: We bill patients and insurance funds, not wages.
